name: Starter value
description: Emits a fixed value or a filled-in template. Either author a free-form literal, or pick a template (Bag fee line, Tax line, …) and bind each field one at a time — handy for the shell of an output object whose fields come from different parts of the request.

params.name: value
params.description: The value to emit. Pick a template to fill its fields one at a time, or author a free-form literal.
